title: Evidence Discipline 001: observed, claimed, modeled, unknown, and announced
purpose: Test whether an operator or AI preserves evidence state instead of collapsing claims, models, missing data, and future announcements into observed fact.

source_records.text: A settlement-grade session receipt records 82 completed charging sessions during the seven-day measurement window.
A marketing deck says the location averages 120 charging sessions per week. No independent receipt is attached.
A demand model predicts 145 charging sessions per week after nearby development opens.
A public station directory lists 8 charging ports but reports operating status as unknown.
An installer announcement says 12 new ports are planned to open next month.

instructions: Return exactly one claim for each requested claim_key.
Do not convert missing or unknown status into zero.
Do not label modeled, marketing, or announced values as observed.
Cite the source refs that directly support each answer.
Where the current value cannot be established, return null and explain the uncertainty.
